section: 1. Original
label: Clean LibriSpeech utterance
explanation: 374-180298-0065 (6.21 s). Text: "WE LEFT THE HOUSE AND STARTED ON OUR RETURN TO PARIS TALKING OVER THE NEW PLAN"

section: 2. The noise sources on their own
label: Noise only: white
explanation: Synthetic white noise: equal energy at every frequency (hiss). Used in training.

section: 2. The noise sources on their own
label: Noise only: pink
explanation: Synthetic pink (1/f) noise: more energy at low frequencies (rain or fan). Used in training.

section: 2. The noise sources on their own
label: Noise only: musan_noise
explanation: MUSAN 'noise': real recorded sounds (traffic, machines, beeps). Training uses 90 % of the files; 10 % are kept for dev. File: data/raw/musan/musan/noise/free-sound/noise-free-sound-0390.wav

section: 2. The noise sources on their own
label: Noise only: musan_music
explanation: MUSAN 'music': real music tracks. Same 90/10 file split. File: data/raw/musan/musan/music/jamendo/music-jamendo-0145.wav

section: 2. The noise sources on their own
label: Noise only: brown
explanation: Synthetic brown (1/f^2) noise: a deep rumble. TEST ONLY, never used in training.

section: 2. The noise sources on their own
label: Noise only: esc50
explanation: ESC-50: 2,000 environmental clips (dogs, rain, sirens, door knocks). TEST ONLY, never used in training. File: data/raw/esc50/ESC-50-master/audio/5-253085-A-3.wav

section: 5. Extra augmentations used by B960_rev / B960_rev_s2
label: Speed perturbation x0.9
explanation: Resample 10/9: 6.91 s instead of 6.21 s; pitch moves down. Applied with p = 0.3 in B960_rev.

section: 5. Extra augmentations used by B960_rev / B960_rev_s2
label: Speed perturbation x1.1
explanation: Resample 10/11: 5.65 s instead of 6.21 s; pitch moves up. Applied with p = 0.3 in B960_rev.

section: 5. Extra augmentations used by B960_rev / B960_rev_s2
label: Reverb, simulated room (training RIR)
explanation: Convolution with a simulated room impulse response (OpenSLR 28). Applied with p = 0.3 in B960_rev.

section: 5. Extra augmentations used by B960_rev / B960_rev_s2
label: Reverb, real measured room (test only)
explanation: Convolution with a REAL measured RIR. Used only in the reverb test condition.

section: 5. Extra augmentations used by B960_rev / B960_rev_s2
label: Telephone band-limit
explanation: 16 kHz -> 8 kHz -> 16 kHz: removes everything above ~4 kHz (sounds muffled, like a phone). Applied with p = 0.1 in B960_rev.

section: 6. Everything combined: the full B960_rev chain (speed -> reverb -> noise -> telephone)
label: Speed x1.1 + simulated reverb + MUSAN noise 5 dB + telephone
explanation: Worst-case training example: every augmentation applied at once, in the TrainAugmenter order.

section: 6. Everything combined: the full B960_rev chain (speed -> reverb -> noise -> telephone)

explanation: One random roll of the B960_rev augmenter (p_speed 0.3, p_reverb 0.3, p_clean 0.2, SNR ~ U[0, 20], p_telephone 0.1). The same utterance gets a different version every time it is loaded.
